'''Blue Two''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the second member of [[Blue Squadron]]. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadrons with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Blue Two.

==History==
The [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] [[Axe (clone trooper)/Legends|Axe]] flew under the call sign Blue Two, [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], before his death at the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]].<ref name="SOR" />

Blue Two was the call sign of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] pilot [[Ru Murleen]] when she flew with [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="RA" />

[[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] flew an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptor]] under the call sign Blue Two while performing [[recon on Corrupter Task Force]], escorting transferred flight staff between the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari cruisers]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] and [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], and investigating intelligence provided by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] defector [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zaletta]] of a convoy tied to a [[Death Star II/Legends|vast Imperial construction project]]. He returned to the call sign during the [[Battle of Kothlis]], flying an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] to cover the evacuation of ''[[Kothlis II]]''.<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Blue Two is the call sign given to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] and [[Star Wars (1977) 6|comic adaptation]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], but he is identified as [[Red Two/Legends|Red Two]] in the final film.<ref name="ANHn">''[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]''</ref><ref name="SW6">[[Star Wars (1977) 6|''Star Wars'' (1977) 6]]</ref><ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
